newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Enersis says not in power talks.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Enersis says not in power talks.

text.p: Chilean power investment company Enersis SA said Tuesday it is not in talks to sell its share of local generator Endesa to Spanish state power utility, also known as Endesa.
Newspaper El Diario, quoting sources in the Spanish company in Madrid, said Enersis is negotiating to sell its 25.27 percent stake in Endesa for between $900 million and $1.1 billion.
"The sale of the shares in Endesa has not been offered to any company or national or foreign bank, so the information published today lacks all basis," said Jaime Ale, corporate affairs manager.
"The board of the company has always considered that Enersis' shareholding in Endesa is an essential asset."
Enersis recently took control of Empresa Nacional de Electricidad (Endesa), Chile's largest power generator, and has investments in local distributors Chilectra and Rio Maipo.
